title: New investigator or Edit investigator
purpose: Record a requesting investigator as a professional contact.
summary: Record a requesting investigator as a professional contact. Admin and manager only.

tasks.title: Add an investigator
steps: Type the [[Code]] and [[Name]], choose the [[Institution]] and add work contacts if known.

tasks.title: Stop offering them
steps: Clear [[Active]], give the [[Reason]] and select [[Save changes]].

good_to_know: Once a request names the investigator, the code and institution are fixed.

items.label: Name
items.description: Required; a professional contact, not a user account.

items.label: Active
items.description: Edit only. Clear to stop offering the entry for new records; existing records keep it.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required when changing, optional when creating. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Fixed once used
paragraphs: Once a request names the investigator, its code and institution are fixed. Fixed fields are shown read-only with the reason Fixed: recorded data already uses this entry; create a new entry instead.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

A new entry may carry an optional reason (blank reads Initial definition); a change needs a reason, kept in the history shown under the form. After saving you return to the list. If someone else changed the record since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; the form keeps your entries and the next save uses the current version, so check the current values first.
Entries are never deleted; clear Active to stop offering one.
